items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: Did you ever see Chink Martin, age 74, walking along the street a mile a minute ahead of everybody else with a tuba under one arm and a bass fiddle under the other? That's a sight.

ctx.x: Most of the old timers say that the tuba was a little bit heavy. I mean, didn't have quite...
Did you ever see Chink Martin, age 74, walking along the street a mile a minute ahead of everybody else with a tuba under one arm and a bass fiddle under the other? That's a sight.
I've heard Chink, of course, play, remember those records that he made for Tulane one time.
